text.p: High temperatures of 90F or above will dominate much of the Plains, Midwest, and East in the USA the next few coupld. In the Southwest, desert regions will see temperatures near 120F in some areas. Heat-related problems are expected as a result of the widespread hot weather affecting many major cities.

Hurricane Felicia, with 75 mph winds, is centered about 850 miles west southwest of southern Baja California, moving west northwest at 8 mph. Felicia will threaten shipping as it continues this track and strengthens during the next 24 hours.

Tropical Depression 04 is nearly stationary about 230 miles southwest of New Oreleans, Louisiana, in the Gulf of Mexico. Top winds are 35 mph. This system is expected to strengthen and be named Tropical Storm Danny during the day as it begins to move slowly east northeast, affecting shipping in the region.

Northeastern India and Bangladesh have seen heavy rain and major flooding in recent days. Property and crop damage has occurred. More showers and thunderstorms in the coming days may further complicate the flooding situation.
